pricing.publishedMessage: v{version} is live. Your company can now be matched with a price.
pricing.noDraftBody: A published price book cannot be changed. Editing means cloning it into a new draft — clone a version below, or start from scratch.
pricing.basePricesHelp: These are the products you said you sell on the Products screen. A product with no price is simply not in this book, and you are matched for it as “price on request”.
pricing.optionPricesHelp: Only the options you marked as offered are listed. An option with no price counts as zero and the customer is told the range may be incomplete.
pricing.noOptions: Mark the options you offer on the Products screen first.
pricing.regionalHelp: Add a delivery and installation difference for a distant province. A district row overrides a city row.
pricing.rulesHelp: Volume discounts and size surcharges. Rules apply to the subtotal independently rather than stacking on each other, so their order never changes the result.
pricing.simulatorHelp: Try your price book here before publishing. Publishing to look is not a workflow — a published book is what customers are quoted.
pricing.unpriced_product-not-in-book: This product is not priced in the book. Give it a unit price.
pricing.unpriced_missing-basis: No dimensions given, so nothing could be calculated.
pricing.warnNonMonotonic: Careful: your {at} m² project comes out cheaper than your {previous} m² one. Your discount threshold is inverting the total.
pricing.warnRuleNeverFires: This rule did not fire at any size tried — check its threshold.
pricing.warnFloorDominates: Your minimum project value applies at every size, so your unit price has no effect.
pricing.noPublished: You have no published price book yet.
